mission_08: Excellent work on this challenging mission! You implemented the Gram-Schmidt orthogonalization process from scratch, converting three vectors into an orthonormal basis. You verified orthogonality by confirming all pairwise dot products are essentially zero. You built the projection matrix and used it to project an arbitrary vector onto the subspace. The projection gives the closest point in the subspace to the original vector. This is the mathematical engine behind least-squares fitting, signal decomposition, and the orthogonal layers used in some neural network architectures.
